notes.title: Diadra Empty Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 08-18-2016
1. Stage 7 music update.
2. Windows alert when pressing the escape button in Window Mode.
3. Kill All Bears Achievement update: kill all bears on stages 2-7 in one play. If player missing a bear, killing additional bears will not count. Kill All Bears counter is reset when starting a new game.

Update 08-16-2016
4. Achievement #3 Level 7 Shooter updated: collect 60k coins
5. Achievement #5 Master Defender updated: kill 50 defenders.
6. Achievement #4 What a player updated: play 10 times to unlock.
7. Achievement #15 Need for Speed updated: buy 16 speed powerup’s levels in one play

Update 08-12-2016
8. Modified the Game Over Rank alignment of local scores and replays
9. Added new Unicode font for additional language support.
10. Fixed autoshoot when moving
11. Updated DxLibrary to DX11
12. Increased screen scroll on leaderboards
13. Negative leaderboards scores are not shown
14. Fixed max value scores to whole integers
15. Fixed Leaderboards center alignment
16. Fixed leaderboard displaying wrong languages

Update 27-07-2016
17. Fixed Japanese Language default options
18. Fixed missing rank entry due to wrong language

-Achievement erasure bug fixed.
